purpose: Provide GitHub dashboard indicators without presenting uncalibrated priors as empirical forecasts.

funnel_depth.formula: points for highest verified downstream stage

new_client_probability_proxy.formula: 1 - product(1 - stage_operational_prior) over mutually exclusive active opportunity stages
assumptions: Uses operational priors only, not empirical calibrated probabilities.
Uses an independence approximation across active opportunities.
Must be labelled UNCALIBRATED and LOW confidence until minimum samples are met.
Must never be used for weighted revenue pipeline unless calibrated probability and monetary value both exist.
new_client_probability_proxy.display_rule: Show as percentage with an explicit UNCALIBRATED / LOW CONFIDENCE warning.
